title: Render MVC and Razor Pages without obsolete runtime-compilation registration
goal: Remove obsolete AddRazorRuntimeCompilation calls when rebuilding MVC or Razor Pages for .NET 11; keep default build-time view compilation and choose Hot Reload for local authoring.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: Use the matching ASP.NET Core server runtime. Recorded .NET 11 execution uses RC2, not GA.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: An SDK supporting this target is required; exact authoring pin is 11.0.100-rc.2.26504.105.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Declared example language mode, separate from runtime requirements.

frameworks: ASP.NET Core MVC and Razor Pages
packageAssets: Microsoft.AspNetCore.App net11.0 shared framework and Microsoft.NETCore.App runtime assets; no extra package in the current route. Historical .NET 10 comparison explicitly pins Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Razor.RuntimeCompilation 10.0.13 and its net10.0 asset.
providers: Kestrel loopback HTTP; no database, account or external resource.
platforms: Supported ASP.NET Core server platforms; measured execution only Windows x64. No browser/WASI, native or AOT claim.
renderingModes: Server-rendered MVC .cshtml views and Razor Pages; not Blazor components.
prerequisites: Keep each complete project in a separate directory using the shown build/package boundary, SDK pin and source files. Restore the declared assets before running. Guidance retrieval itself is offline.
constraints: MVC/Razor Pages only. ASPDEPR003 completes runtime-compilation obsoletion; the runtime behavior of retained registration is unchanged. Remove registration/package for default build-time compilation, use Hot Reload during development. Build-time compilation was already valid on .NET 10. Not F# compiled-view publishing, custom runtime file-provider equivalence or Blazor component guidance.
stabilityLimitations: The used public API is stable/non-experimental; .NET 11 routes are prepared with RC2 evidence under ADR 0004 and await GA reconciliation. ASPDEPR003 marks obsoletion, not an experimental API or a runtime behavior change.

sources.title: Additional overloads now warn; runtime behavior is unchanged
Razor runtime compilation obsoletion and Hot Reload alternative

evidence.scope: Actual Windows x64 .NET 10.0.13 build and two loopback HTTP requests through historical RuntimeCompilation 10.0.13 net10.0 assets: MVC and Razor Pages return original HTML and encode model data. Local ASPDEPR003 suppression for historical comparison only.

Actual Windows x64 .NET 11 RC2 build and two loopback HTTP requests: MVC and Razor Pages render build-time compiled views and encode model data without any runtime-compilation package or registration. No browser/Hot Reload edit execution or GA claim.

humanProof.scope: Local compilation and real HTTP checks require no Human-only resource. No claim of Hot Reload edits, browser/device behavior, broad platform coverage, GA readiness or publication.
